सौखशायनिकः, सौखशायिकः [
सुखशयनं पृच्छति ठक्] One who asks
another person whether he has slept
well or has had comfortable sleep;
भृग्वादीननुगृह्नंतं सौखशायनिकानृषीन्
R. 10. 14.

सौखशायनिकः, सौखशायिकः [
सुखशयनं पृच्छति ठक्] One who asks
another person whether he has slept
well or has had comfortable sleep;
भृग्वादीननुगृह्नंतं सौखशायनिकानृषीन्
R. 10. 14.

सौखसुप्तिकः [सुखसुप्तिं सुखेन शयनं
पृच्छति ठञ्]
1 One who asks another
person whether he has slept well.
--2 A bard whose duty it is to
waken a king or any other great
personage with song and music.

सौखिक a. (की f.), सौखीय a.
(यी f.) Relating to pleasure,
pleasurable, delightful.

सौख्यं Pleasure, happiness,
satisfaction, felicity, enjoyment.
